# -----------------------------
# Simulate dataset
# -----------------------------
set.seed(123)

# Sample size
n <- 200

# Covariates
x1 <- rnorm(n)
x2 <- rbinom(n, 1, 0.5)

# True coefficients
beta0 <- -0.5
beta1 <- 1.2
beta2 <- -0.8

# Linear predictor
eta <- beta0 + beta1 * x1 + beta2 * x2

# Probability via logistic function
p <- 1 / (1 + exp(-eta))

# Response variable (binary)
y <- rbinom(n, 1, p)

# Create dataframe
data <- data.frame(y, x1, x2)

# -----------------------------
# Fit logistic regression
# -----------------------------
fit <- glm(y ~ x1 + x2, data = data, family = binomial)

# Print summary
summary(fit)

# -----------------------------
# Plot predicted probabilities
# -----------------------------
library(ggplot2)

data$pred_prob <- predict(fit, type = "response")

ggplot(data, aes(x = x1, y = pred_prob, color = factor(x2))) +
  geom_point(aes(y = y), alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    y = "Predicted probability",
    color = "x2",
    title = "Logistic Regression Predictions"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
